items.name: MISSION PLANNING / BRIEFING - DEBRIEFING
execution: 1/ SP plans appropriately mission IAW Squadron’s Tactical Standards. Planning includes all data calculations (T/O, Climb, Enroute, Descent and Landing).
2/ SP prepares her/his mission with regards to:
a/ All data and details (flight altitude selection, significant ground references, alternate airfields etc) and
b/ Required conditions and restrictions such as Weather, NOTAMS, Flight plan etc.
3/ Furthermore, Ν44ΧΧ and Ν45ΧΧ must be applied corresponding items as described in formation sorties.
conditions: 2/ SP has all the available means for preparation and mission planning.
4/ Furthermore, Ν44ΧΧ and Ν45ΧΧ must be applied corresponding items as described in formation sorties.

general_criteria.text: SP fills the flight plan.
Plots route on map correctly.
Has a good knowledge how to use performance charts (Flight manual), aeronautical maps, and MAIP.
Selects significant ground references per leg.
Fills his/her mission card correctly without omissions. He/she uses all available aeronautical publications (MAIP, χάρτες, FLIPs, etc), Flight Manual, AFMAN 11-202 VOL3 and Flight Procedures manual.
Executes briefing and debriefing without omissions.
Furthermore, Ν44ΧΧ and Ν45ΧΧ must be applied corresponding items as described in formation sorties.
Chooses alternate airfields and plans in flight (with logical error) heading, time κaι fuel in every turning point to nearest airfield.

cross_refs: Furthermore, Ν44ΧΧ and Ν45ΧΧ must be applied corresponding items as described in formation sorties.
flags: «Ν44ΧΧ» / «Ν45ΧΧ»: ελληνικά Ν (U+039D) και Χ (U+03A7) — Λατινική ανάγνωση «N44XX» / «N45XX» (κωδικοί ασκήσεων σχηματισμού). Εμφανίζεται 3 φορές (execution 3/, conditions 4/, general criteria g/).
Στο general criterion e/ η λέξη «χάρτες» είναι ελληνική μέσα σε αγγλικό κείμενο (= «maps») — διατηρήθηκε όπως τυπώνεται.

Το EXECUTION 2/ φέρει υπο-ρήτρες a/ και b/· καταγράφηκαν ως ξεχωριστές εγγραφές στο execution.

items.name: BASIC A/C CONTROL / WINGMAN CONSIDERATION

general_criteria.text: All corresponding criteria from Contact and Formation categories (depending on training Section) are applied. Furthermore, SP:
Ιs able to calculate accurately fuel in flight that are related with time and distance.
Modifies mission’s profile in order not to violate fuel restrictions.
Is aware of IAS (depending on flight altitude, winds) per leg, set appropriate power settings.
Executes deliberate airspeed changes IAW Techniques and Procedures Manual, when it is needed, in order to be exactly above turning points at calculated time.
Has a good knowledge and executes flight altitude changes IAW Techniques and Procedures Manual.
Executes all required in-flight procedures.

items.name: IN-FLIGHT PLANNING / FORMATION INTERGRITY
execution: 1/ SP modifies mission profile appropriately in order to accomplish his/her mission safely.
2/ Ν44ΧΧ and Ν45ΧΧ must be applied corresponding items as described in formation sorties.

general_criteria.text: SP is able to modify mission’s profile in order to avoid unfavorable weather conditions.
Is capable of calculating precisely fuel in flight that are related with time and distance.
Modifies flight plan without making mistakes in-flight, if required.
Modifies flight altitude so that minimum altitudes with obstacles are not violated.
Knows safety altitude per leg in which he/she flies and RAA as well.
Uses properly altitude correction techniques during turns.
Knows flight altitudes that affect nearby airports and is cognizant of the mnemonic (semicircular) rule for VFR flight altitudes.
Is capable of modifying the A/C heading whenever necessary so that he/she avoids obstacles and/or returns to the right track.
Knows and executes heading changes if it is required to correct his/her ground track.
Is able to turn and roll out at right heading if it is required due to weather conditions or was asked to do it.
Is capable of modifying the track when necessary due to unexpected issues such as weather and returning back to the track the fastest possible.
Deviates his track only when objective difficulties are present (e.g. clouds), following IP￿s permission and has the ability to recalculate time and fuel if necessary.
Furthermore, Ν44ΧΧ and Ν45ΧΧ must be applied corresponding items as described in formation sorties.

cross_refs: Ν44ΧΧ and Ν45ΧΧ must be applied corresponding items as described in formation sorties.
